The '''Diatia Major system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] region.<ref name="EAOC" /> It contained<ref name="Fry" /> the [[Star/Legends|star]] [[Diatia Major]], which was [[Orbit/Legends|orbited]] by the large, mysterious ring known as the [[Diatian Clockwork]].<ref name="Author's Cut" />
